_comment: The root of the agent-workflow conformance lattice. RECONSTRUCTED 2026-09-18 (bean m4zg): `session-start`, `commit-hygiene` and `content-lifecycle` all declared `derivedFrom: ["req:agent-workflow"]` and it had never existed, so three requirements specialised a parent with no obligations in it. Every statement here is the shared obligation those three already assert in their own terms — nothing new is required of anybody by this file. `kg:audit`'s `requirement-derived-from-resolves` criterion is what surfaced the hole.
title: Agent Workflow
description: An agent working in a folio instance works to a declared process, records what it is doing where a human and a sibling session can see it, and does not act outside the role it is acting as.

statements.label: Work in progress is visible to others
statements.requirement: An agent SHALL record what it is working on in the shared work plan before doing it, so a human can steer and a sibling session does not pick up the same item.

statements.label: An agent acts as a declared role
statements.requirement: An agent performing a task in a process SHALL do so as a role the process's lane binds, using that role's skills. It SHALL NOT perform a step belonging to a lane it is not acting in.

statements.label: Process position is declared, not improvised
statements.requirement: Where a BPMN process governs the work, the agent SHALL take its next step from that process rather than deciding the order itself, and a step that is not enabled SHALL be refused.

statements.label: Judgement calls are not assumed
statements.requirement: An agent SHALL NOT record a human judgement — an approval, a sign-off, a decision to release — on that human's behalf.

statements.label: A decision handed over carries its context
statements.requirement: When an agent hands a decision to a person, it SHOULD state what differs between the options and what each costs, so the decision is answerable without opening anything.
